svg.title: AES-CBC latency across batch sizes
svg.desc: Two panels compare CPU eager and MPS compiled byte-interface latency. Both axes are logarithmic. Each message has 16 blocks. Four neural variants and native CPU AES are shown in black and white. The CPU reference is repeated in both panels.
